title: Tune-Up Allowance and Scope by CareLine Plan
content:
**Field service standard — CareLine Service Plans annual tune-ups**

Each tier of the CareLine Service Plans family includes a set number of annual tune-up visits per plan year, each covering a set scope of work. Unused tune-ups do not carry into the next plan year on any tier.

| Tier | Tune-up visits included per plan year | Work included in a tune-up visit | Unused tune-ups carry into the next plan year |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 0 | None | No |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 1 | Inspect and lubricate | No |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 1 | Inspect and lubricate; adjust sashes and locks | No |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 2 | Inspect and lubricate; adjust sashes and locks; clean weep holes; minor screen repair | No |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 2 | Inspect and lubricate; adjust sashes and locks; clean weep holes; minor screen repair | No |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 2 | Inspect and lubricate; adjust sashes and locks; clean weep holes; minor screen repair; exterior caulk check | No |

### The scope items, tier by tier

| Scope item | Basic | Plus | Premier | Premier 3-Year | Estate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inspect and lubricate | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Adjust sashes and locks | — | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Clean weep holes | — | — | Included | Included | Included |
| Minor screen repair | — | — | Included | Included | Included |
| Exterior caulk check | — | — | — | — | Included |

The On-Call Service Account includes no tune-up visits and no tune-up scope.

### Carry-over, shown on hypothetical plan years

| Hypothetical case | Tune-ups available in the next plan year |
|---|---|
| CareLine Premier Plan, one of its 2 tune-ups used in a plan year | 2 (the unused one does not carry over) |
| CareLine Basic Plan, its 1 tune-up unused in a plan year | 1 |
| CareLine Estate Plan, both of its 2 tune-ups used in a plan year | 2 |

On the CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan the allowance of 2 applies to each of the three plan years inside its 36-month term, and does not carry from one of those plan years into the next.
